title: WorkItem
description: Durable orchestration record for one deliverable issue. The controller's source of truth for orchestration; GitHub is the source of truth for facts (issue/PR/commit/merge). One WorkItem = one issue = one branch = one PR.

parentGoalId.description: Set for child issues of an epic. Parent completion depends on all children.

acceptance.description: Frozen at intake. A merge is not completion until each doneWhen is checked.

headSha.description: The commit the controller last dispatched/observed on the branch.

reviewedSha.description: The commit the latest accepted gate verdict applies to.

gateRound.description: Mirror of pr-gatekeeper's round number. Never incremented by controller retries.

attempts.description: What was tried and what each try did, one entry per attempt. Mirrors OpenBot job_blocked.tried.

blockedOn.description: The one thing that must be supplied before work can continue. Required while state is blocked.

blockers.description: Fingerprinted unresolved findings, for same-problem round counting.

stateVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. Every durable write increments it.

providerTaskId.description: The provider's id for the active task.

sessionNative.description: True when sessionHandle resumes the harness's own session.

owner.description: Named human owner, required while state is human_waiting.

doneWhen.description: A check read back from the produced artifact (a command, a file, a test), never from effort spent.

state.description: merged, closed, cancelled and exhausted are terminal. exhausted = budget hit, neither done nor blocked. human_waiting is NOT terminal: it is an action queue with a path back to ready or closed.

fingerprint.description: Stable hash of path + normalized problem text. Identity of 'the same problem'.
